Alertroid is an independent, unofficial app. It listens to the same push channel Google uses for Android earthquake alerts, which Google may change or stop at any time. It is not a certified warning system: keep your phone\'s official emergency alerts enabled.

Alertroid warns you of earthquakes seconds before the shaking reaches you, and of other public alerts for your area, using Google's Android earthquake-alert broadcasts directly—without Google Play Services or a Google account.

To be fast and reliable it must stay connected in the background, know roughly where you are, and be allowed to sound an alarm even in silent and Do Not Disturb mode. Please grant the permissions below.

Privacy: only your coarse area (a ~40 km cell, mixed with three other places) is sent to Google's push server, together with an anonymous device identity. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

Some manufacturers (Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung, OnePlus, Oppo…) stop background apps despite the settings above. If alerts stop, also allow \"autostart\" and disable any app-specific battery saver for Alertroid. See dontkillmyapp.com for your phone.
Grant the required permissions to continue
To show earthquake warnings and keep the background connection running.
To know which area to receive alerts for and to count down until shaking reaches you. Network location is used; GPS only briefly and rarely, when nothing else works.
So your area is kept up to date when you travel, including after a reboot. Choose \"Allow all the time\".
Lets Alertroid keep its connection during deep sleep (Doze) and restart itself if stopped. Without this, warnings can arrive late or not at all.
Data Saver is on and blocks background data for this app. Allow unrestricted data so alerts arrive.

Normally your location is detected automatically. You can set it by hand instead.
How often the connection is checked. Shorter notices dead connections sooner but uses a little more battery. Deep sleep may stretch it to about 10 minutes.

Choose up to three other places you care about (family, home town…). You will be notified about earthquakes and alerts there, without the countdown. They are also the \"decoys\" that hide your real area from Google; any slot you leave empty gets a random automatic decoy, whose alerts are only logged.
Or long-press on the map to set the selected place.
